details.description: Naturally processed from soya beans, 50% chilli pulp ensures its purity. Made the traditional Chinese way, Pou Chong's dark soya bean sauce is authentically Chinese. Armed with a recipe that's perfected over generations and quality handpicked ingredients, the dark soya sauce has a deeper colour and more body than its contemporaries. A great marinade, the dark soy sauce can render a rich colour to your noodle preparations.
details.ingredients: SUGAR, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, CARAMEL III (INS 260), SOYABEAN SOYABEAN III,CARAMEL IV (INS 150d), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 211), INS 224, , WATER, WHEAT, JAGGERY (40%)
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry and hygienic place
